name: SiteFooter
summary: The foot of every page: the wordmark, a footer navigation and a copyright note under a chrome line.

guidance.useFor: The bottom of every page: secondary links (contact, accessibility statement, privacy) and the copyright.
insteadUse: The main sections of the site: Site header
A newsletter sign-up: CTA band, before the footer
content: Keep the note to one line

rungReason: <footer> is the contentinfo landmark and <nav aria-label> a navigation; plain links.

a11y.role: contentinfo (footer at the end of the body), with a navigation landmark
a11y.name: The navigation: its aria-label ("Footer")

keyboard.action: Reaches the wordmark, then each link

rules: Two navigations on one page need different names: Main and Footer
The chrome line is decoration; the footer is a landmark either way
forcedColors: The chrome line becomes a CanvasText border
